answer: Agents file deposits inside an umber relic vault; the vault’s kernel burns the deposit at a rate of 0.7% per on-chain pulse, but recharges 10% only if the identity completes a valid flow proof in the next pulse. Hit the relic twice with a Sybil and the kernel drains 0.7% twice in sequence without recharging, so each fake identity costs the 0.7% burn that cannot be batched because the relic’s pulse timer resets per agent.
